learning_outcomes.text: Compares information technologies with current technologies.
Understands how developments in software and hardware can be applied to other fields.
Contributes to the formation of business ideas.

syllabus_topics: Information Technology, Hardware, Software and Computer from Past to Present
Balance of power in the informational world
Where are we in the process.
Are information technologies increasingly beneficial or harmful?
Our position regarding current technological developments
The future of information technologies, Artificial Intelligence Applications, Mobile Applications
